name: @althar/desktop
description: Althar's desktop app: Electron, with the runtime in a utility process and the interface in the window.

scripts.build: vp build --config vite.node.config.ts && vp build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vp build --config vite.overlay.config.ts && vp build
scripts.build:package: vp build --config vite.node.config.ts --mode package && vp build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vp build --config vite.overlay.config.ts && vp build
scripts.measure:startup: bun run build && bun build scripts/measure-startup.ts --target=node --external=@playwright/test --external=electron --outfile=test-results/measure-startup.mjs && node test-results/measure-startup.mjs > test-results/startup-measurements.jsonl
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test:coverage
scripts.verify:all: bun run verify && bun run test:e2e
